metrics.assumption_note: Same frozen weekly assumed sigma 4.1%, independent zero-drift Gaussian 2-of-5 trading sessions only. Conditional exercise applies generic Gaussian scaling even to non-Gaussian hybrid intervals; not a calibrated or archived prospective probability.

hypothesis_tests.Q001: A single CPI MoM target favors hybrid direction Brier over the simple no-change arm, but this is one observed release, cannot alter prior negative signal from other targets, and gives no new econometric fit.
hypothesis_tests.Q002: Intermediate Nikkei gain emphasizes realized-path conditioning of final tail event; current 90% interval can be crossed in two sessions under a simple iid Gaussian sensitivity model, no evidence of forecast miscalibration until Friday.
hypothesis_tests.Q004: The original Nov7 model predicted two CPI YoY values the BLS cannot publish, an avoidable specification mistake detected on Nov10 before publication. Confirmed directly in official Nov10 release. Add an eligibility gate for next prospective forecast; archived old targets stay untouched.
hypothesis_tests.cross_market_event_timing: The US Nov13 PPI release at 08:30 EST is 22:30 JST, 7 hours after Tokyo Nov13 15:30 close. Causal impact of the ACTUAL post-close PPI data cannot explain the already-fixed Friday Tokyo Nikkei closing return. Event anticipations before Tokyo close remain possible. Do not align all assets under a uniform same-time news impact.
